about: The scripted auditor of tests/full-audit.e2e.test.ts: one verdict per RGAA criterion the worklist of tests/fixtures/full-audit-app hands over. `cite: "all"` cites every evidence anchor the worklist harvested for that criterion (copied from the worklist, never retyped); `except` leaves out the anchors a verdict does not clear; `at` names the evidence anchor an NC finding is drawn from (by file, selector, snippet or note; `from` reads it in another criterion's evidence). A criterion may also settle EACH PAGE of the audit (#197): `pages` maps an audited page id to its own ruling — verdict, `justification`, `cite: "page"` (which cites the anchors on that page's own capture, representatives or `alsoAt` siblings — never another page's) and its own `findings` (`at` an anchor on that page's capture, or `observed` there directly when the harvest anchored it on another state) — and `pagesElse` rules every page left unnamed. The run-wide verdict stays what it is; the per-page outcomes are what close every page cell of the strict `--require-decided=pages` gate. A criterion missing here fails the test by name, so a worklist that changes shape is seen, not silently filled.
